title: Minimum Operations to Sort With Locked Indices
statement: The task is to sort a permutation of 1..n (n up to 2000) using adjacent swaps, allowed only between two unlocked indices, plus at most k unlocks, minimising swaps plus unlocks. Swaps always equal the inversion count. The minimum unlocks are the locked indices inside non-trivial prefix-max chunks, so the answer is inversions plus unlocks, or -1 if more than k are needed.
